eat.title: Where to eat in Taroudant
eat.subtitle: Medina tables, garden spots and easy cafés around Assarag.

nadia.title: Chez Nadia
nadia.desc: Intimate medina spot known for home-style tagines, pastillas and fresh bread.

jardins.title: Les Jardins de Taroudant
jardins.desc: Shaded garden and terrace dining mixing Moroccan classics with French-inspired plates.

roudani.title: Restaurant Roudani
roudani.desc: Lively square-side stop for generous tagines, omelettes and mint tea.

zitoune.title: Dar Zitoune
zitoune.desc: Olive-grove setting serving local produce, grilled meats and seasonal dishes.

jnane.title: Jnane Soussia
jnane.desc: Garden and caidal tent near the ramparts for tajines, grills and family meals.

arcades.title: Café Les Arcades
arcades.desc: Easy central terrace on Place Assarag for coffee, snacks and casual plates.
